name: JavaScript
summary: Adversaries may abuse various implementations of JavaScript for execution. JavaScript is a platform-independent scripting language (compiled just-in-time at runtime) commonly associated with scripts in webpages, though JavaScript can be executed in runtime environments outside the browser. JScript is the Microsoft implementation of the same scripting standard. JScript is interpreted via the Windows Script engine and thus integrated with many…

strategies.name: Behavioral Detection of JavaScript Execution in ICS

analytics.name: Analytic 2092
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies wscript.exe/cscript.exe/mshta.exe or other JScript execution from unexpected parents/paths, especially when followed by child interpreters, network connections, or system modification. Alert only when the interpreter is not part of the asset's approved software/automation baseline or its execution context violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/user rule, and require OT-relevant corroboration such as access to engineering files, ICS software/API use, communications with protected OT assets, configuration change, or another suspicious follow-on behavior. Suppress documented vendor software, engineering workflows, diagnostics, backup, patching, and…

analytics.name: Analytic 2093
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies node/nodejs or another JavaScript runtime launched from an unexpected service, web process, scheduled task, user, or path, followed by outbound connections, shell execution, persistence, or OT-relevant access. Alert only when the interpreter/shell is not expected for the asset role or user/service context, or when its parent, path, arguments, remote-session source, or follow-on behavior violates the approved OT baseline. Suppress approved engineering scripts, vendor support, diagnostics, backup, patching, and maintenance windows.
